title: Session 4: cross-host continuity simulation
goal: Show that a second host can bootstrap the same user and agent-profile memories.

arguments.task_hint: Find another batch of AI opportunities for the same user from a different host.

expected_context_pack_contains: host_id differs from Session 1 and Session 2

steps.text: Even from a different MCP host, I should use the same continuity context: prioritize AI Agent or MemoryAgent opportunities, value credential and founder-network lift, verify deadline/timezone/eligibility from primary sources, and exclude region-ineligible events from recommendations.
